Australia Awards Masters Scholarship

Provider: Australian Government

Degree: postgraduate Master's study in Australia

Field of study: priority fields including information technology

Funding Type: return air travel, establishment allowance, full tuition fees, contribution to living expenses and health cover

Eligible Nationalities: suitably qualified Africans from eligible countries including Benin

Country of study: Australia

Eligibility criteria: International applicants may apply from abroad and return home after study

Deadline: 30 April 2031
